description: This file declares functions, structures, and macros for speech encoding, specifically for the AMR speech codec. It includes function prototypes for initializing, resetting, and encoding speech frames, as well as related data structures.

methods.name: GSMInitEncode
methods.description: Initializes the speech encoder instance, setting up necessary states and returning success status.

methods.name: Speech_Encode_Frame_reset
methods.description: Resets the speech encoder state memory to zero, preparing for a new encoding session.

methods.name: GSMEncodeFrameExit
methods.description: De-initializes the speech encoder, freeing allocated resources.

methods.name: Speech_Encode_Frame_First
methods.description: Prepares the encoder for encoding a new speech frame, initializing post-filter states.

methods.name: GSMEncodeFrame
methods.description: Encodes a speech frame into serial bit stream based on the specified mode.
